name: Sovereign Mission Intelligence
headline: Turn scattered evidence, private AI, and governed automation into one decision-support operating layer.
audience: Owner-operators, regulated SMBs, municipalities, MSPs, and AI teams that need dependable intelligence without handing sensitive operations to a black box.
pain: Operational facts are scattered across dashboards, tickets, model runs, spreadsheets, and alerts. Teams cannot tell what is healthy, what matters next, or which action is safe to automate.
offer: A tailored Sovereign Mission Intelligence implementation: evidence collection, private inference routing, operational context, explainable analysis, approval-gated actions, and a buyer-ready operating brief. We map the decision loop to your systems, keep sensitive workloads local where practical, and leave you with documented ownership rather than an opaque dependency.
price: From CAD$2,500 discovery / implementation quoted to scope
support: Discovery workshop, architecture map, implementation handoff, documented runbooks, and human support during the agreed onboarding window.
assurances: No claim of perfect autonomy: approval gates remain explicit for consequential actions.
Private-first routing and data minimization are designed into the implementation.
Evidence, assumptions, and recommendations remain distinguishable in the operating brief.
